Study.Title: Synthetic test record — not data
Study.Note: One invented decision-maker's path through the five gates, used only to prove the decision-path layer validates (ADR-013). Excluded from every count and analysis. The instrument elements are copied from the study so reasons can point to real questions.

g:GateModel.author: Scott Santucci
g:GateModel.g:Definition: My NEW version of this a series of binary gates that are designed to track choices (which is the foundational source of reality) and to measure state change

g:Gate.label: Target
g:Gate.g:Question: Did the vendor and then the salesperson target the right message to the right people (Target 1 or 0)

g:Gate.label: Access
g:Gate.g:Question: Did the vendor and then the salesperson gain access to the right people (Access 1 or 0)

g:Gate.label: Agree
g:Gate.g:Question: Did the vendor and then the salesperson gain agreement with the right people to explore the idea further (Agree 1 or 0)

g:Gate.label: Vision
g:Gate.g:Question: Did the vendor and then the salesperson gain a shared vision of success with the right people (Vision 1 or 0)

g:Gate.label: Case
g:Gate.g:Question: Did the vendor and then the salesperson provide a business case for the idea the client accepts (case 1 or 0)

Scale.Rationale: Pick all that apply — each choice is selected or not
Scale.Option: I pursued the opportunity with a different vendor.
I could not envision how the value would be delivered.
It became too risky of a purchase.
Others internally got involved and the effort to keep the momentum became too great.
I struggled to get others on board internally.
I didn't have a clear path in my mind on who I'd delegate this assignment to for successful execution.

Scale.Rationale: From 'simple to build a case' down to 'limited materials'; 'other' and 'don't know' sit outside the order
Scale.Option: It would be a simple task for me to develop convincing business justification for the purchase.
I can quantify specific impacts and how they change for different environments. Limited customization necessary.
I can quantify specific impacts, but not how they change for different environments. Significant customization necessary
I can identify potential impact, but not quantify them. We had to do most of the business justification ourselves.
Limited materials were provided. We had to do all of the business justification ourselves.
